Title: Frozen
Plot: Fearless optimist Anna teams up with rugged mountain man Kristoff and his loyal reindeer Sven in an epic journey to find Anna's sister Elsa, whose icy powers have trapped the kingdom of Arendelle in eternal winter.

Title: Frozen II
Plot: Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf and Sven leave Arendelle to travel to the ancient autumnal forest of an enchanted land. They set out to find the origin of Elsa's powers in order to save their kingdom.
